verdict.rationale: First-party DGX B300 docs cover the story's core. They document an 8-GPU system with 2.3 TB of pooled GPU memory, a cluster network of 8 x 800 Gb/s InfiniBand/Ethernet via ConnectX-8, and rack deployment options (MGX and enterprise racks, busbar power, SuperPOD scale-out), and NIM docs cover multi-node serving via LeaderWorkerSets/MPI. An independent HGX B300 8-GPU server review corroborates the multi-GPU system. missing for 10: explicit NVLink/NVSwitch intra-node interconnect bandwidth documentation, SuperPOD rack-scale topology details, independent hands-on evidence of multi-node training at scale.
